apa.name: American Psychiatric Association
apa.why: Defines the global diagnostic standard for mental illness
apa.mission: Advance psychiatry and improve mental health care quality and access worldwide.
apa.impact: Created DSM-5-TR — the primary diagnostic reference used by every licensed clinician globally.

nice.name: National Institute for Health & Care Excellence
nice.why: Gold standard for evidence-based treatment pathways globally
nice.mission: Improve health and social care through evidence-based guidance.
nice.impact: Shapes treatment protocols, cost-effective care models, and quality benchmarks adopted worldwide.

samhsa.name: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration
samhsa.mission: Improve access, quality, and outcomes for behavioral health services nationwide.
samhsa.impact: Operates 988 Crisis Lifeline, national treatment locator, and federal prevention frameworks.

nimh.name: National Institute of Mental Health
nimh.mission: Transform understanding and treatment of mental illness through research.
nimh.impact: Drives innovation in neuroscience, diagnosis methodology, and new treatment modalities.

nih.name: National Institutes of Health
nih.mission: Turn scientific discovery into better health for all people.
nih.impact: Foundational science underpinning all modern healthcare — clinical trials to translational research.

cdc.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention – Mental & Behavioral Health
cdc.why: Population-level mental health surveillance and prevention
cdc.mission: Protect public health and safety through prevention, preparedness, and promotion.
cdc.impact: Defines national mental health trends, suicide prevention programs, and behavioral risk data.

gwi.name: Global Wellness Institute
gwi.why: Defines wellness as prevention — not treatment
gwi.mission: Empower wellness worldwide through research, education, and collaboration.
gwi.impact: Frames a multi-trillion-dollar wellness economy and positions prevention as primary healthcare strategy.

nwi.name: National Wellness Institute
nwi.why: Standardized the most widely adopted holistic well-being model
nwi.mission: Promote whole-person wellness across individual, organizational, and community levels.
nwi.impact: Operationalizes well-being via the Six Dimensions of Wellness framework used globally.

iwbi.name: International WELL Building Institute
iwbi.why: Connects physical environment to mental and physical health outcomes
iwbi.mission: Improve health and well-being through better building design and environments.
iwbi.impact: Drives well-being design standards in workplaces, healthcare facilities, and housing.

oxford.name: Wellbeing Research Centre — University of Oxford
oxford.why: Global leader in scientifically measuring well-being
oxford.mission: Advance understanding and measurement of well-being to inform policy and practice.
oxford.impact: Influences global happiness metrics and national policy decisions worldwide.

ggsc.name: Greater Good Science Center
ggsc.why: Converts research into real-world well-being practices
ggsc.mission: Study the psychology, sociology, and neuroscience of well-being and teach practical skills.
ggsc.impact: Scales evidence-based emotional well-being tools for individuals and organizations.
healconnect: Adaptive engagement based on behavior signals

ppc.name: Positive Psychology Center — UPenn
ppc.why: Academic origin of modern well-being science
ppc.mission: Advance research on strengths, resilience, and optimal human functioning.
ppc.impact: Shapes modern well-being frameworks used in healthcare, coaching, and digital health.

afh.name: Action for Happiness
afh.why: Scales community well-being globally through accessible programs
afh.mission: Help people create a happier and more caring society.
afh.impact: Democratizes well-being via structured, evidence-based courses and programs worldwide.

nccih.name: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health
nccih.why: Provides scientific validation of mind-body and integrative care
nccih.mission: Define the usefulness and safety of complementary health approaches through rigorous research.
nccih.impact: Bridges traditional and modern medicine — brings evidence rigor to meditation, yoga, and integrative therapies.

acimh.name: Academic Consortium for Integrative Medicine & Health
acimh.why: Integrates whole-person care into mainstream hospital systems
acimh.mission: Advance integrative medicine through education, research, and advocacy.
acimh.impact: Accelerates adoption of holistic care models across leading health systems.

ifm.name: Institute for Functional Medicine
ifm.why: Root-cause, systems biology approach to personalized health
ifm.mission: Transform healthcare by addressing underlying causes of disease.
ifm.impact: Enables longitudinal, personalized wellness care and chronic disease prevention.

gallup.name: Gallup
gallup.why: Defines measurable well-being and engagement at organizational scale
gallup.mission: Provide analytics and insights to improve workplace and life outcomes globally.
gallup.impact: Establishes well-being as a business KPI — productivity, burnout, and engagement as measurable outcomes.

wef.name: World Economic Forum
wef.why: Elevates well-being to a global economic and policy priority
wef.mission: Improve the state of the world through public-private cooperation.
wef.impact: Positions mental health and well-being as core to economic resilience and workforce productivity.

shrm.name: Society for Human Resource Management
shrm.why: Operationalizes employee well-being in corporate strategy
shrm.mission: Empower HR professionals to build better workplaces and workforce outcomes.
shrm.impact: Drives corporate adoption of well-being programs, mental health initiatives, and people analytics.

oecd.name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
oecd.why: Measures and defines well-being beyond GDP at national level
oecd.mission: Promote policies that improve economic and social well-being globally.
oecd.impact: Established the Better Life Index — the primary national well-being benchmark used by governments.

undp.name: United Nations Development Programme
undp.why: Expands well-being into human development, equity, and sustainability
undp.mission: Advance sustainable development and improve quality of life globally.
undp.impact: Introduced the Human Development Index (HDI) — a foundational global well-being metric.

nami.name: National Alliance on Mental Illness
nami.why: Connects clinical systems to real people — advocacy at scale
nami.mission: Provide advocacy, education, and support for individuals and families affected by mental illness.
nami.impact: Expands access to care and reduces stigma through peer support, helplines, and education.

hr.name: HealthRight International
hr.why: Connects health and human rights — equitable access for underserved populations
hr.mission: Ensure equitable access to healthcare for vulnerable and marginalized communities globally.
hr.impact: Expands care to underserved populations through community health and mental health programs.
